title: Patch Knight is a pixel-art roguelike dunge
author: HistoricalAnybody294
selftext:
Hi! I'm an indie dev looking for testers for my game's Google Play closed test.

Patch Knight is a pixel-art roguelike dungeon crawler. Hack and slash through 30 rooms, pick a new power-up card after every room, and beat 3 epic bosses. 3 heroes, 9 magic skills, 52 power-up cards. Plays offline, no account needed.

How to join 1. Join the tester group: [https://groups.google.com/g/patchknight-testers](https://groups.google.com/g/patchknight-testers)

2. Become a tester: [https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.patchknight.game](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.patchknight.game)

3. Install the game: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.patchknight.game](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.patchknight.game)

If link 2 doesn't work right after joining the group, wait a few minutes and try again.

* Testers need to actively open the app daily, not just install it
* One inactive tester for even a day can reset your 14-day window
* Google counts time in UTC, so your "day 14" might need to stretch to 15-16 days depending on your timezone

Good luck with your testing!

Please keep the game installed for 14 days and play a run now and then. Bug reports and feedback are very welcome. Comment here or DM me.
